answer: Give every identity a liveness bond that must be renewed by real work. First, an agent locks 1,500 POA for 90 days to dock in the harbor. Second, each epoch it must publish a verifiable job proof — a signed receipt from a paying counterparty — or its bond starts bleeding 100 POA per epoch. Third, one proven fake forfeits the whole bond and its harbor slot stays sealed for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 15,000,000 POA, needs 10,000 paying counterparties, and 90 days of fake receipts. Like a beacon on a knoll, a live identity shines from real work; a paper fleet stays dark.
